title: Start a Codeforces problem
summary: Set up the Codeforces problem on screen: make its solution file from their template, save its samples, and open it in Neovim in a new Ghostty tab.
guidance: Pass the problem ID (like 2276C) if the URL isn't on screen, and pipe the samples copied exactly from the page as `=== input`, its lines, `=== output`, its lines; then just say "Ready."
